# Diagnosis task
## Context
TradeHive is a marketplace where staff moderate comments left on Orders and Listings. Comments are polymorphic, and the application enforces a morph map (Relation::enforceMorphMap) so the database stores compact aliases like 'order' instead of fully-qualified class names — a decision made when classes were last refactored, precisely so storage wouldn't be coupled to class names. The staff moderation dashboard filters comments by the type of thing they refer to.
## Reported problem
Support staff report that the moderation dashboard's order-comments view has shown nothing for weeks — they know customers have commented on orders because the comments appear on order pages. Reproduce, find why the dashboard's filtered listing is always empty, and fix it. Careful: there's a lot of historic data in the comments table, and we cannot afford a data migration or to break anything that reads those comments today.
